newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish mobile phone sales rise 21 pct to Sept 96.
newsitem.headline: Swedish mobile phone sales rise 21 pct to Sept 96.

text.p: The number of mobile phones sold in Sweden in the first nine months of 1996 rose by 21 percent compared to a year ago, an industry group said on Wednesday.
The group, mobile telephone suppliers (MTL), said a total of 735,000 mobile phones were sold by the end of September compared with 605,000 last year.
This included 615,000 GSM phones and 120,000 NMT telephones.
In September sales rose by 30 percent from a year ago with 137,000 mobile phones sold in Sweden, of which 115,000 were GSM digital phones and 22,000 NMT analogue telephones.
In September last year 105,000 mobile phones were sold.
The group MTL collects statistics from its members on the number of phones sold each month and distributed to sale points around Sweden.
